items: For a franchise, one underperforming location can drag down the whole brand, so reputation needs to be managed across every location at once.
In food and beverage, reputation works as your marketing engine, so monitor, respond to and act on feedback from every source as an ongoing practice.
Keep one consistent brand voice in review replies, even when franchisees with different operators handle their own locations.
Measure reputation by location so you can spot struggling stores early and turn scattered guest feedback into fixes at the network level.
